feeds.title: Apneists UK Blog
feeds.description: Our page contains many useful articles for freedivers to learn about new freediving equipment, new books, freediving trips, and other useful information. Apneists UK was Established in 1999 we are the oldest Freediving club in the UK. We run regular courses and pool sessions alongside open water trips and holidays both in the UK and abroad. Our world-class athletes have set many Freediving records and regularly participate in the World Championships.

feeds.title: One Breath Freediving Blog
feeds.description: Hi, I'm David Watson. Here on our website, you can view our latest news and activities directly through our blog. Have you ever dreamed of swimming like a dolphin or wondered what it feels like to glide through the ocean with a single breath? At One Breath Freediving on the Mediterranean island of Malta, we can teach you how! We have an unrivaled knowledge of the dive sites around Malta after having conducted thousands of dives and training sessions around the Maltese Islands.

feeds.title: Professional Association of Diving Instructors Blog
feeds.description: PADI blog shares articles in the context of Scuba Diving and Freediving Tips, Dive Travel Insights & More. PADI is one of the world's largest ocean exploration and diver organizations. It enables people around the world to seek adventure and save the ocean through underwater education, life-changing experiences, and travel.

feeds.title: Freedive Nusa Blog
feeds.description: Freedive Nusa is a freediving school in Bali. On this website, you'll get the detailed information regarding the freediving course at Freedive Nusa. We are passionate about freediving. We love to share our experience and connection with the ocean by teaching others how to hold their breath and how to be free underwater. We are a team of experienced freediving instructors, who will lead you to the world of freediving.

feeds.title: Liquidstate Freediving
feeds.description: Liquidstate Freediving is the first to bring AIDA freediving education to Fiji. We are driven by the passion for freediving and want to share that passion with you. Freediving can be a positive life-changing experience. We can help you to unlock your body's potential to dive in one breath. We use only late model, state-of-the-art equipment and we choose to dive and training sites with the best possible conditions to make your experience as fun and safe as possible.

feeds.title: Freediving in United Arab Emirates
feeds.description: Freediving UAE was founded in 2009 and was the first and only company in the UAE specializing in courses and training in Freediving. It is a community of freedivers who have a passion for passively exploring the underwater world. We don't just instruct courses, we show you how to become a good freediver and give ongoing support to all of our students. We are aiming to make the UAE one of the main freediving destinations in the world.

feeds.title: Freedive Cosmos Blog
feeds.description: Hi, I'm Taylan Ülger the founder of Freedive Cosmos. In our blogs, you will get updates regarding news, events, experiences, reviews, equipment, and freediving training. Freedive Cosmos is Turkey's First Molchanovs Freediving School. We conduct certified freediving courses and regular training, from beginner to instructor level in the Molchanovs Freediving education system, and also have the most complete and professional system with the highest standards in training and performance.

feeds.title: Freedive UK Blog
feeds.description: Hi, I'm Ian Donald, AIDA instructor trainer, and Freedive UK course director. Here you can learn to freedive with renowned freediver. The Freedive UK is an AIDA freediving and spearfishing school. Our goal is to break the stereotype of the competition freediver and bring freediving to the wider market.

feeds.title: Live Free Diving Blog
feeds.description: Through our blogs, we share our exciting freediving experiences, informative articles regarding freediving, and many more. Our team is built of passionate ocean lovers with a strong foundation in sustainability, adventure, and education. Whatever your interest and skill level, we've got you covered! From Freediving, SCUBA, and Snorkeling- our courses and adventures provide an intimate way to get in touch with life below the surface

feeds.title: Freediving Freedom
feeds.description: This blog is to teach you how to unlock longer bottom times, greater depths, and more powerful freediving experiences. Our website, Freediving Freedom provides resources, gear suggestions, and diving tips to help freedivers globally discover new ways to dive deeper, boost breath-hold times, and max under-water bottom time.

feeds.title: InDepth » Freediving
feeds.description: This section of our blog features articles that have to do exclusively with the Freediving sector. Hi, I'm Michael Menduno the founder of InDepth. Our mission is to supply readers with accurate, compelling, hand curated, and researched, data-driven content to assist them in expanding their underwater envelope. We share a desire to safely explore and protect the underwater world and improve the quality of scuba, technical, cave diving education, and aquatic research.
